description: A latching switch: while it is engaged the output carries a constant voltage you set, and while it is off the output is 0V

params.text: Switches the latch on with one press and off with the next; the lamp in it glows while the latch is on
Sets the voltage the output carries while the latch is on, 0V to 10V, and it starts fully clockwise at 10V

inputs.text: A rising edge above 2V flips the latch, exactly as a press of HOLD does; it rearms once the voltage falls below 0.1V
Added to the CONST trimpot volt for volt while the latch is on, with the total held between 0V and 10V

outputs.text: The voltage set by CONST plus the modulation input while the latch is on, and 0V while it is off

notes: the output stays at 0V until the latch is switched on, either by pressing HOLD or by a trigger at the trigger input
the modulation input is only read while the latch is on, so a voltage there cannot lift the output off zero by itself
the latch state is saved with the patch, and a newly added module comes up with the latch off
the module is monophonic: both inputs are read as one channel and the output carries one channel

inputs.0:
high above 2V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.1:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 10V.
